_schema._comment: Hand-curated by the owner. Entries with "example": true are skipped by the loader. Validation lives in api/_lib/destination_catalog.py (validate_entry / validate_catalog). Do not add an entry without a real source link for every highlight and hotel area.
_schema.iata: string, 3 uppercase letters, unique across the file
_schema.tags: non-empty list, each one of: food, city, culture, nature, beach, shopping, nightlife, relax
_schema.highlights: 3 to 5 objects {title, note, sourceUrl}; sourceUrl must start with https://
_schema.hotelAreas: 2 to 3 objects {name, note, sourceUrl}; sourceUrl must start with https://
_schema.mapQuery: non-empty string, the search text for a map link
_schema.lastChecked: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, the day the sources were last checked
